messages:
alex: Heads-up: I'm kicking a small frontend slice deploy (slice id 3) at 18:30 UTC. Planned bake 15m. Will validate smoke endpoints and feature flags. pinging ops for metric watch :eyes:
maya: Got it — I'll run the smoke script and sanity checks once canary is up. posting checklist below.
sam: I'll monitor p95 latency and errors on model-serving routes (gen and embeddings). Alert me @jordan if anything > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for frontend-slice-3 by alex. Image: registry.redwood/inference/frontend:release-2026.rolling
lia: Quick smoke commands (run after canary is healthy):
```
# health
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.dev/health || echo FAIL
# basic generation sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"Say hi"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text' | head -n1
```
maya: Running the above now on canary instance ip 10.4.22.7
ci-bot: Canary deploy finished on host-10.4.22.7, checks: container up, migrations none, new config applied
alex: @maya @lia can you also confirm token-cost telemetry is flowing (route: /v1/generate token_count) — want to ensure no invoice surprise
maya: Token telemetry ok, small uptick during warmup only :thumbsup:
sam: First 5m metrics: p95 gen = 210ms (baseline 200ms), errors 0.2% (baseline 0.1%) — watching for noise; will re-evaluate at 15m
jordan: If errors climb above 0.5% we should rollback slice 3 and scale down autoscaler for that pool. Keeping standby rollback ready.
alex: Good plan. If nothing bad by +15m we roll forward to remaining slices.
maya: Smoke asserts: health=200, generate returned 'Hi', token telemetry present, no log errors on canary. Marking as PASS at +6m :white_check_mark:
sam: Metrics stable at +12m. Slight cold-start spikes subsided. p95 back to 198ms, errors 0.12%
deploy-bot: Canary marked healthy. Proceeding to slice roll for frontend-slice-4..7.
alex: Thanks all — leaving the thread open for any late quirks. If anyone sees anomalies drop into this thread :rotating_light:
ci-bot: Roll started for slices 4-7. Notifying release channel
maya: Quick note: found a minor log spam from debug flag still on in one instance, toggled off. Not affecting correctness but added a follow-up ticket 2h backlog.
jordan: Noted, follow-up fine. Roll looks clean so far.
alex: Closing bakewatch — moving to postroll monitoring. Will update if we see regressions. :rocket:
